description: Test suite for the ContextCachingEndpoints class in the litellm project, focusing on caching logic, cache creation, cache checking, URL construction for Google Vertex AI endpoints, and both synchronous and asynchronous methods. Contains multiple test cases using pytest, mocking external dependencies and HTTP calls.

classes.name: TestContextCachingEndpoints
